name: 04093 · Buxton, ME
findings: ZIP 04093 (Buxton) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 04093 (Buxton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
